props.team: Customer onboarding and identity verification working group

people.name: Maximiliana Alexandrovna Konstantinopoulou-Whitfield
people.yesterday: Spent most of the day pairing with the database team on the replication lag we saw during the Friday load test, then wrote up what we found, including the three queries that hold locks for more than two seconds and the index we think would fix two of them.
people.today: Roll the new index out to the staging replica, rerun the load test with the same traffic profile, and compare lag against the baseline before asking for a production window.
people.blocker: Cannot get a production change window until the platform council signs off, and the council does not meet again until next Thursday, which pushes the replication fix past the quarter-end freeze unless someone with approval rights can grant an exception sooner than that. Until then every large import keeps the replicas minutes behind, and support is already seeing tickets about stale balances on the dashboard. A temporary workaround would be to throttle the imports, but that needs a config change in the scheduler that only the platform team can make.
